name: AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2
description:
AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2 is a dataset featuring the antigen-variable domain of heavy 
chain of heavy chain antibody (VHH) interactions obtained from two alpacas 
immunized with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 
spike proteins. AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2 includes binary labels indicating the binding 
or non-binding of diverse VHH sequences to 12 SARS-CoV-2 mutants, such as 
the Delta and Omicron variants. AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2 provides valuable benchmarks 
for evaluating the representation capabilities of antibody language models for 
binding prediction, thereby facilitating the development of AI-driven antibody discovery.
creator: Hirofumi Tsuruta, Hiroyuki Yamazaki, Ryota Maeda, Ryotaro Tamura, Akihiro Imura
citation: Tsuruta, H., Yamazaki, H., Maeda, R., Tamura, R., & Imura, A. (2024). A SARS-CoV-2 Interaction Dataset and VHH Sequence Corpus for Antibody Language Models. arXiv preprint arXiv:2405.18749.
